name: 7-Day Afghanistan Journey
summary: Seven days from Kabul to the Bamyan valley and the blue lakes of Band-e-Amir, with Kabul’s museum, gardens, bird market and old mosques on either side of the highland road.
accommodation_note: Standard hotels: Park Star Hotel in Kabul (nights 1, 5 and 6) and Gholghola Hotel in Bamyan (nights 2, 3 and 4).

name: Afghanistan Discovery Tour Spring
summary: Witness the dramatic transformation of the Afghan landscape as spring brings lush valleys and blooming orchards to Kabul, Bamyan, and the ancient streets of Herat.
group_size_display: Group departures 6–18 (minimum 6 confirmed) · private on request
accommodation_note: 3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul, Herat and Bamyan

name: Afghanistan Discovery Tour Fall
summary: Explore the legendary historical sites of Kabul, Bamyan, and Herat framed by the brilliant golden hues, crisp air, and seasonal harvests of an Afghan autumn.
accommodation_note: 3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul, Herat and Bamyan

name: Bamyan Skiing Tour
summary: Six winter days in the central highlands: a dedicated Koh-e-Baba backcountry ski-touring day, an optional second outing when conditions allow, and Bamyan’s heritage sites under snow. Backcountry ski touring, not resort skiing.
accommodation_note: 3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul and Bamyan

name: Buzkashi Expedition
summary: A thrilling, fast-paced winter journey centered around witnessing Afghanistan's fierce and spectacular national sport, Buzkashi, played across the northern plains.
accommodation_note: 3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul and Mazar-e-Sharif.

name: Kabul & Surroundings
summary: Discover the fascinating layers of Afghanistan's capital city and its nearby valleys, exploring bustling bazaars, historic gardens, and spectacular mountain passes.

name: Weekend in Kabul
summary: A condensed but rich itinerary perfect for short-stay travelers looking to experience the vibrant markets, historical landmarks, and culinary highlights of Kabul.

name: Winter Circuit
summary: Journey through the quiet, snow-covered beauty of central and northern Afghanistan, offering an unforgettable perspective on local life during the serene winter months.
accommodation_note: 3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul, Mazar-e-Sharif and Bamyan

name: Summer Circuit
summary: Take advantage of the perfect mountain weather to traverse the ancient trade routes connecting the high valleys of Bamyan with the northern plains of Mazar-e-Sharif.
accommodation_note: 3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul, Mazar-e-Sharif and Bamyan

name: Treasures of the Silk Road
summary: An epic cross-country expedition tracing the footsteps of ancient traders, connecting the blue-tiled mosques of Mazar-e-Sharif and Herat with the heart of Kabul.
accommodation_note: 3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul, Bamyan, Herat and Mazar-e-Sharif

name: The Timurid Grandeur of Herat
summary: Delve into the artistic and architectural pinnacle of Islamic history, exploring the magnificent minarets, citadels, and tile-making workshops of western Afghanistan.
accommodation_note: 3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul and Herat

name: The Timurid Grandeur of Herat — Additional Minaret-e-Jam
summary: An extraordinary rugged trek extending your western tour deep into the mountains of Ghor to witness the legendary, UNESCO-listed 12th-century Minaret of Jam.
accommodation_note: 3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul and Herat.

name: Trekking the Wakhan Corridor
summary: A premier, high-altitude wilderness expedition into the remote Wakhan Corridor, hiking alongside rivers and meeting the hospitable, nomadic Wakhi and Kyrgyz peoples.
accommodation_note: 3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul, Mazar-e-Sharif and Faizabad. While in the Wakhan camping tents.
transport_note: Flight Kabul-Faizabad; 4WD to Ishkashim then horses/hiking

name: Panjshir Valley: Emeralds & History
summary: Four days based in Kabul with a full day trip into Panjshir: the river valley, mountain villages, the Massoud Mausoleum when access allows, and an introduction to the emerald trade. No overnight in Panjshir.
group_size_display: Private from 1 traveler · shared departures minimum 2
accommodation_note: Standard hotel in Kabul for all three nights; no overnight in Panjshir.

name: Kandahar: The Durrani Empire
summary: Journey south to the birthplace of modern Afghanistan to explore the grand shrines, rich political history, and vibrant fruit markets of the historic Durrani capital.
accommodation_note: 3-star and 4-star hotels in central Kabul and Kandahar
